verdict.rationale: The pack shows a static API reference (endpoint listings, a Templates API page, a Messages API page) and TypeScript code examples in llms.txt. Nothing shows an interactive explorer or in-browser runnable examples, such as a 'try it' console or API playground. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, and copyable code snippets plus a test token are adjacent building blocks rather than an interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
